verdict.rationale: Telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a consumer authenticator app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting to opt out of telemetry, analytics or usage tracking. The cited privacy and security features (encrypted backups, PIN/TouchID protection, disabling multi-device or new installs) are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
